@@U04232@@
So much for him and his precious stick!
Besides, it’s useless to us,
what with that cross thing at one end!

@@U04234@@
What do we do now?

@@U04236@@
Do? It’s all but done!
Hurry, now, my black little cousins,
off to work at the mountain lake!
Greet the Undines, and tell them
we need to borrow some pretty water tricks.
They have an art we havent,
they’re female,
they know how to separate illusion from reality
so everyone thinks it’s the real thing.

@@U04237@@
(Pause.)

@@U04239@@
Our ravens must have
flattered those ladies with a vengeance.
I see a trickle beginning over there.
And there a once dry rocky place
is flowing rapidly.
They can never win now.

@@U04241@@
What a grand way to greet them!
Their boldest climbers are at a loss.

@@U04243@@
A single brook divides into many brooks
that then leap out of gulches twice their size.
And there, another, a river,
casts its arching back far out and down,
translation:
@@U04232@@
他和他珍贵的棍子就这么多了！
再说了，对我们来说也没啥用，
一端有那个交叉的东西怎么办！

@@U04234@@
我们现在做什么？

@@U04236@@
做吗？一切都完成了！
快点，我的黑人小表弟们，
去山湖边上班吧！
向 Undines 夫妇打招呼，并告诉他们
我们需要借用一些漂亮的水戏法。
他们有我们没有的艺术，
他们是女性，
他们知道如何区分幻想和现实
所以大家都认为这是真的。

@@U04237@@
（停顿。）

@@U04239@@
我们的乌鸦一定有
复仇地奉承那些女士。
我看到那里开始有一股细流。
还有一个曾经干燥的岩石地方
正在快速流动。
他们现在永远不可能赢了。

@@U04241@@
这是多么盛大的方式来迎接他们啊！
他们最大胆的登山者不知所措。

@@U04243@@
一条小溪分成许多小溪
然后从两倍大的峡谷中跃出。
那里还有一条河，
将其拱形背部向外和向下投射，
